intent.logline: A figure steps out of a tear in the sky and lands in the middle of a market street.
intent.turn: the crowd waits for a savior -> the arrival is a threat
intent.audience_knows: the crowd is relieved; the viewer sees the tear is wrong

beats.name: establish
beats.goal: the street is ordinary, and already wrong

beats.name: reveal
beats.goal: the figure becomes legible against the tear
beats.knowledge_change: the arrival is a body, not a light

beats.name: charge
beats.goal: it gathers itself before it moves
beats.knowledge_change: it is about to do something

beats.name: impact
beats.goal: the landing answers the crowd's hope

shots.purpose: Make the street react before the figure exists in frame.

emotion.contradiction: flat, everyday daylight for a thing that should not exist

framing.notes: stalls along both edges, sky in the top third

options.name: A
options.start: empty street, crowd small at both edges, sky blank
options.turn: every head tilts up, sky still blank
options.end: the same wide frame, all eyes on nothing
options.tradeoff: knowledge with the crowd; judging distance

options.name: B
options.start: medium on the crowd, heads up, sky out of frame
options.turn: a bright rim enters the top edge

composition.value_masses: white sky band, mid-grey street, black stall silhouettes
composition.focus: the empty centre of the street
composition.negative_space: the sky that will be torn open

camera.motivation: the street has stopped; the camera should too
camera.end_frame: same frame, every head turned up
camera.turn_frame: heads begin to lift; a balloon stops rising; the sky is still empty

action.primary: Everyone in the street stops and turns toward the sky.
action.subtext: They have been waiting for this, and they are wrong to.

sound.diegetic: street ambience cutting to silence, then a low hum

storyboard.panel: wide street, tiny crowd along both edges, every head tilted up, empty white sky above
arrows: dotted eye-lines from the crowd up into the sky

transition_out.matches: the hum carries into the tear

shots.purpose: Show the body, not a light, and let it come down through the frame.

framing.notes: figure in the upper third, tear filling the sky behind

options.name: A
options.start: figure small inside the tear, sky fills the frame
options.turn: tilt down: street enters below, the tear rises out of frame
options.end: figure low in frame, street beneath it
options.tradeoff: we descend with the body; loss of the tear's scale

options.name: B
options.start: low wide, figure a silhouette against the tear
options.turn: figure falls through frame while the camera holds
options.end: figure lands small, tear still overhead
options.tradeoff: we watch from the ground; keeps scale, loses intimacy

composition.value_masses: bright torn band across the top, dark figure centre, grey street below
composition.negative_space: white sky left of the tear

subjects.name: Figure
subjects.pose: one boot forward, coat trailing up

camera.motivation: follow the body down until it owns the street
camera.start_frame: figure small in the tear, sky filling the frame
camera.end_frame: figure low in frame, street visible beneath
camera.turn_frame: the boot leaves the tear; the street appears below the figure

light.key: the tear itself, behind the figure

action.primary: The figure steps out of the tear and falls the last metre.
action.subtext: It falls like it already knows the ground will take it.

sound.diegetic: a low hum, wind pulling upward

storyboard.panel: low angle, small figure inside a bright torn band in the sky, long coat lifted, street dark below
arrows: arrow down along the body path, label DESCEND
storyboard.annotation: S02 · MS · low · tilt down · 2.5 s

transition_out.matches: cut as the boot leaves the tear

continuity: tear stays in the same part of the sky
crowd silhouettes at the bottom edge

shots.purpose: Buy the pause that makes the landing read.

framing.notes: foreground shoulder of a bystander occludes the lower left

composition.value_masses: black figure on the left, white tear behind, grey dust at the feet
composition.negative_space: bright tear burning out the right edge

camera.motivation: the hand closes; the frame closes with it
camera.end_frame: fist closed, dust lifted around the knuckles
camera.turn_frame: the fingers close; dust lifts around the knuckles

action.primary: The figure closes its hand and the dust lifts around it.
cues: dust rises before the hand is shut
action.subtext: It is not gathering power; it is deciding how much to use.

sound.diegetic: the hum drops in pitch, a low pulse

storyboard.panel: low medium close-up, crouched figure left, huge bright tear burning the right edge, dust at the knuckles
arrows: small push arrow at the frame edge
radial short lines at the hand
storyboard.annotation: S03 · MCU · low · push in · 2.5 s

continuity: opposite screen side from S02 so the cut does not repeat

shots.purpose: Answer the crowd's hope with a consequence.

framing.notes: figure centred small, crowd silhouettes across the bottom edge

composition.value_masses: white dust ring expanding, black figure at its centre, dark crowd along the bottom
composition.negative_space: empty street left and right of the ring

camera.motivation: the ground takes the hit; the camera lets it
camera.start_frame: figure an instant above the ground
camera.end_frame: knee down, dust ring across the frame, crowd blown back
camera.turn_frame: knee and fist strike; the dust ring reaches the bottom edge of frame

light.key: tear now behind the figure's back

action.primary: The figure lands and the dust ring throws the crowd back.
cues: coats blow outward before the dust reaches them
action.subtext: The street got its answer, and it is the wrong one.

sound.diegetic: impact, then dust settling, then silence

storyboard.panel: ground-level wide, figure small and centred on one knee, dust ring expanding, crowd silhouettes pushed back along the bottom edge
arrows: radial burst at the impact point
outward arrows along the dust ring

continuity: crowd stays on the bottom edge
bans: no camera shake beyond one frame

rhythm.note: hold the empty street, snap the reveal, hold the pause, let the dust settle
